verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents native SDKs for Python/JS across observability, prompt management, and API/data platform querying (e.g., 'Query via SDKs'), plus 100+ framework integrations and OpenTelemetry support, giving AI-native developers first-class programmatic access. Community feedback corroborates strong DX/integration quality, though some users note prompt management SDK features lag competitors and bulk API retrieval performance issues. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of SDK completeness/versioning, and no explicit public API reference (OpenAPI probe 404s).
